operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table/column names (Rooms, RoomId, roomName, maxOccupancy, CheckIn) — must be double-quoted in generated SQL; case-insensitive lookup.
TEXT PK RoomId holds short uppercase codes (AOB, CAS, FNA) — String fuzzer will emit random charset strings, not code-shaped.
CheckIn/CheckOut are TEXT-stored dates in format 'DD-MON-YY' (e.g. '23-OCT-10', '02-FEB-10') — declared TEXT so TS dispatches to String, not Date; leading-zero day present.
Reservations.Room FK -> Rooms.RoomId, parent exists and is unique (PK); 600 child rows over 10 parents, so heavy duplication expected.
Rooms has only 10 rows; Reservations 600 — child table much larger than parent, FK draw with replacement will repeat parents.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE beyond PKs; all columns nullable in DDL.
Rate is REAL with 2-decimal values (218.75, 287.5) — Number fuzzer with scale from 'real' (no args) will produce wide-range floats.
beds/maxOccupancy/Adults/Kids are small-cardinality INTEGERs (2-4 distinct) — Number fuzzer ignores this and draws from [-10^scale,10^scale].
basePrice INTEGER with 6 distinct values (75..175) — Number fuzzer range far exceeds observed.
No views, triggers, or indexes beyond PKs in DDL.
Table order: Rooms (level 0) before Reservations (level 1) — FK fill works with upstream ordering.
All storage classes match declared types (text/integer/real); no affinity contradictions.
operator_ts_expectations: CheckIn/CheckOut: String fuzzer (declared TEXT) — random charset strings + contamination, NOT date-shaped; any query comparing to 'DD-MON-YY' literals will mostly miss.
RoomId/Room: String fuzzer emits random a-zA-Z0-9() strings, not 3-letter codes; joins still work (FK consistency) but value predicates on codes fail.
roomName/decor/bedType/LastName/FirstName: random strings with contamination — implausible names, likely FN on LIKE/equality predicates.

beds/maxOccupancy/Adults/Kids: Number fuzzer draws from [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale from type args, default 0 -> [-1,1] for bare INTEGER? actually scale=0 -> [-1,1]) — implausible occupancy values, FN on range predicates.
basePrice/Rate: Number fuzzer wide range; Rate scale from 'real' (no args) -> default scale, likely [-10^4,10^4] — implausible prices, FN on price-range predicates.
Code (INTEGER PK): Number fuzzer with PK -> max_l0=inf, fresh draws; values near 0 or perturbed, not 5-digit codes — FN on Code predicates.
FK Room draws from Rooms.RoomId final values with replacement — ties/duplicates abundant (600 rows, 10 parents), good for COUNT/GROUP BY but may FP on DISTINCT-count queries.
Small parent (10 rows) means FK child values cluster; queries expecting uniform distribution may see skew.
String contamination (suffix/prefix/drop-char) creates near-miss values — may cause FP on LIKE '%X%' predicates.
No NOT NULL enforcement in Python; NULLs only from empty parent or dropout — with 10 parents, few NULLs expected.
Date-shaped TEXT columns never get Date fuzzer — a known TS miss for this schema shape (text-stored dates).
